title.fil: Mga station sa sitwasyon, pagbagsak at handover

purpose.en: Practise the habit every first-aid case shares: check the scene, call help through the confirmed contact, observe response and breathing, and hand over facts.
purpose.fil: Sanayin ang gawing pare-pareho sa bawat kaso: suriin ang paligid, tumawag ng tulong sa kumpirmadong contact, obserbahan ang tugon at paghinga, at i-handover ang facts.

group_size.en: Triads (learner, partner, observer), rotating roles; staff rate each learner.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (learner, partner, observer) na nagpapalitan ng papel; staff ang nagra-rate sa bawat isa.

materials.en: Participant cards, worksheets and observation sheets for 2.4.1, 2.4.6 and 2.4.18
materials.fil: Participant cards, worksheet at observation sheet ng 2.4.1, 2.4.6 at 2.4.18

materials.en: First aid and referral job aid with the confirmed contact filled in
materials.fil: Job aid na Paunang lunas at tamang referral na may nakasulat na kumpirmadong contact

materials.en: Tape or chalk to mark a pretend road or hazard
materials.fil: Tape o tisa para markahan ang kunwaring kalsada o panganib

steps.en: 2.4.1 (40 min): read the fallen-rider case. The learner marks hazards, assigns the bystander to call the confirmed contact, states response and breathing observations, and gives the location.
steps.fil: 2.4.1 (40 min): basahin ang kaso ng nadapang sakay. Tutukuyin ng learner ang panganib, uutusan ang saksi na tumawag sa kumpirmadong contact, sasabihin ang tugon at paghinga, at ibibigay ang lokasyon.

steps.en: 2.4.6 (20 min): collapsed adult, relative offers a sweet drink. The learner activates help, states response and breathing observations, declines oral intake and keeps watching.
steps.fil: 2.4.6 (20 min): bumagsak ang adult at may nag-alok ng matamis na inumin. Hihingi ng tulong ang learner, sasabihin ang tugon at paghinga, tatanggihan ang pagpapainom at patuloy na magbabantay.

steps.en: 2.4.18 (25 min): a health worker arrives. The learner gives a timed, factual handover (situation, response and breathing, timeline, actions, needs) and asks the receiver to confirm the next action.
steps.fil: 2.4.18 (25 min): dumating ang health worker. Magbibigay ang learner ng maikling factual na handover (sitwasyon, tugon at paghinga, oras, ginawa, kailangan) at hihilinging kumpirmahin ang susunod na hakbang.

steps.en: After each round, the observer gives one strength and one retry action; the learner retries, then roles rotate.
steps.fil: Pagkatapos ng bawat round, isang lakas at isang retry action mula sa observer; uulit ang learner, saka magpapalit ng papel.

debrief.en: Which step was hardest to do before calling for help?
debrief.fil: Aling hakbang ang pinakamahirap gawin bago tumawag ng tulong?

debrief.en: What did the receiver need that you almost left out?
debrief.fil: Ano ang kailangan ng tatanggap na muntik mong makalimutan?

observe.en: 2.4.1: marks hazards, assigns the call, states response and breathing, gives a concise location.
observe.fil: 2.4.1: tinutukoy ang panganib, nagtatalaga ng tatawag, sinasabi ang tugon at paghinga, ibinibigay ang lokasyon.

observe.en: 2.4.6: safe activation, response/breathing observation and handover without oral intake.
observe.fil: 2.4.6: ligtas na pagtawag, obserbasyon sa tugon at paghinga, at handover nang walang pagpapainom.

observe.en: 2.4.18: timed, factual handover; invites the receiver to confirm the next action.
observe.fil: 2.4.18: maikli at factual na handover; hinihiling sa tatanggap na kumpirmahin ang susunod na hakbang.

output.en: One completed worksheet per lesson and one staff rating per learner per indicator observed.
output.fil: Isang worksheet bawat aralin at isang staff rating bawat learner sa bawat naobserbahang indicator.

alternative.en: Solo or low-resource: talk through the cases aloud with the job aid, complete the worksheets, and arrange staff observation later.
alternative.fil: Kung mag-isa o kulang sa gamit: isalaysay nang malakas ang kaso gamit ang job aid, sagutan ang worksheet, at magpaobserba sa staff pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Element / observed evidence / next action (scene, call, report, confirmed contact, time and handover)
worksheet.fil: Elemento / nakitang ebidensya / susunod na hakbang (paligid, tawag, ulat, kumpirmadong contact, oras at handover)

title.fil: Mga station sa batang may sakit

purpose.en: Recognize danger signs and breathing concerns, explain packaged ORS from its own label, and activate urgent referral without labelling the illness.
purpose.fil: Kilalanin ang danger signs at hirap sa paghinga, ipaliwanag ang ORS ayon sa sariling label nito, at mag-refer agad nang hindi nagbibigay ng diagnosis.

group_size.en: Triads: learner as BHW, partner as caregiver, observer; staff rate.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan: learner bilang BHW, partner bilang tagapag-alaga, observer; staff ang nagra-rate.

materials.en: Participant cards, worksheets and observation sheets for 2.4.2, 2.4.3 and 2.4.4
materials.fil: Participant cards, worksheet at observation sheet ng 2.4.2, 2.4.3 at 2.4.4

materials.en: An empty ORS sachet with its printed directions (dry simulation; no mixing)
materials.fil: Walang-lamang ORS sachet na may nakalimbag na panuto (tuyong simulation; walang pagtitimpla)

steps.en: 2.4.2 (25 min): Niko cannot drink and is hard to wake. The learner names at least one danger sign, activates urgent referral and repeats the exact observation in a handover.
steps.fil: 2.4.2 (25 min): hindi makainom si Niko at mahirap gisingin. Tutukuyin ng learner ang kahit isang danger sign, magpapa-agarang referral at uulitin ang eksaktong nakita sa handover.

steps.en: 2.4.3 (25 min): Aya struggles to breathe; the family wants to wait. The learner describes breathing, asks about danger signs and uses the confirmed route for urgent assessment.
steps.fil: 2.4.3 (25 min): hirap huminga si Aya at gustong maghintay ng pamilya. Ilalarawan ng learner ang paghinga, itatanong ang danger signs at gagamitin ang kumpirmadong daan sa agarang pagsusuri.

steps.en: 2.4.4 (30 min): baby Mina, still breastfeeding. The learner reads the packet label aloud, explains safe water and continued breastfeeding, and names a referral trigger.
steps.fil: 2.4.4 (30 min): si baby Mina na sumususo pa. Babasahin ng learner ang label ng sachet, ipapaliwanag ang ligtas na tubig at pagpapatuloy ng pagpapasuso, at sasabihin ang referral trigger.

steps.en: Observer gives one strength and one retry action; learner retries; rotate roles.
steps.fil: Isang lakas at isang retry action mula sa observer; uulit ang learner; magpapalit ng papel.

debrief.en: How did you respond when the family wanted to wait?
debrief.fil: Paano ka tumugon nang gustong maghintay ng pamilya?

debrief.en: Why do the mixing directions come from the packet and not from memory?
debrief.fil: Bakit sa sachet nanggagaling ang panuto sa pagtimpla at hindi sa alaala?

observe.en: 2.4.2: identifies at least one danger sign, activates urgent referral, repeats the observation factually.
observe.fil: 2.4.2: tinutukoy ang kahit isang danger sign, nagpapa-agarang referral, inuulit ang nakita nang factual.

observe.en: 2.4.3: describes breathing, asks about danger signs, activates the confirmed urgent assessment route.
observe.fil: 2.4.3: inilalarawan ang paghinga, itinatanong ang danger signs, ginagamit ang kumpirmadong daan sa agarang pagsusuri.

observe.en: 2.4.4: uses the packet label, explains safe water and continued feeding, identifies a referral trigger.
observe.fil: 2.4.4: ginagamit ang label ng sachet, ipinapaliwanag ang ligtas na tubig at pagpapasuso, tinutukoy ang referral trigger.

output.en: Three worksheets per learner and staff ratings for indicators 2.4.2–2.4.4.
output.fil: Tatlong worksheet bawat learner at staff rating para sa indicator 2.4.2–2.4.4.

alternative.en: Without a sachet, use a drawn label copied from a locally available packet; solo learners complete the worksheets and are observed later.
alternative.fil: Kung walang sachet, gumamit ng iginuhit na label na kinopya sa lokal na pakete; ang mag-isa ay sasagot sa worksheet at oobserbahan pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Element / observed evidence / next action (drinking, alertness, breathing, referral, confirmed contact)
worksheet.fil: Elemento / nakitang ebidensya / susunod na hakbang (pag-inom, kamalayan, paghinga, referral, kumpirmadong contact)

worksheet.en: ORS sachet / actual packet instruction / shown or retry
worksheet.fil: ORS sachet / aktuwal na panuto sa pakete / naipakita o uulitin

title.en: Supervised manikin stations: CPR/BLS and choking
title.fil: Supervised manikin stations: CPR/BLS at pagkabulon

purpose.en: Under a qualified trainer, practise help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved sequences on manikins only.
purpose.fil: Sa gabay ng qualified trainer, sanayin ang pagtawag ng tulong, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong sequence sa manikin lamang.

group_size.en: Small groups at each manikin with one qualified trainer; the trainer rates.
group_size.fil: Maliliit na grupo sa bawat manikin kasama ang isang qualified trainer; ang trainer ang nagra-rate.

materials.en: Adult and infant training manikins; AED trainer if available
materials.fil: Adult at infant training manikin; AED trainer kung mayroon

materials.en: Worksheets and observation sheets for 2.4.7 and 2.4.15
materials.fil: Worksheet at observation sheet ng 2.4.7 at 2.4.15

materials.en: Cleaning supplies for manikins as the trainer directs
materials.fil: Panlinis ng manikin ayon sa tagubilin ng trainer

steps.en: Confirm the qualified trainer is present. If not, postpone this card; do not substitute.
steps.fil: Tiyaking naroon ang qualified trainer. Kung wala, ipagpaliban ang card na ito; huwag palitan.

steps.en: 2.4.7 (40 min): the trainer demonstrates the current adult sequence; each learner calls for help, requests the AED and follows the trainer-approved sequence on the manikin.
steps.fil: 2.4.7 (40 min): ipapakita ng trainer ang kasalukuyang adult sequence; bawat learner ay hihingi ng tulong, hihingi ng AED at susunod sa aprubadong sequence sa manikin.

steps.en: 2.4.15 (40 min): with adult and infant manikins, the learner decides effective cough versus severe obstruction and shows the trainer-approved age-specific response.
steps.fil: 2.4.15 (40 min): gamit ang adult at infant manikin, ihihiwalay ng learner ang mabisang ubo sa malubhang bara at ipapakita ang aprubadong tugon ayon sa edad.

steps.en: Never practise compressions or thrusts on a live partner. Record each observed action; retry what was not shown.
steps.fil: Huwag kailanman magsanay ng compression o thrust sa totoong kapareha. Itala ang bawat naobserbahang kilos; ulitin ang hindi naipakita.

debrief.en: What must happen before any child or water case uses a different pathway?
debrief.fil: Ano ang kailangan bago gamitin ang ibang pathway para sa bata o pagkalunod?

debrief.en: Why is this station not a CPR/BLS certificate?
debrief.fil: Bakit hindi CPR/BLS certificate ang station na ito?

observe.en: 2.4.7: help activation, AED request and trainer-approved adult sequence on the manikin, each action recorded.
observe.fil: 2.4.7: pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence sa manikin, bawat kilos ay naitala.

observe.en: 2.4.15: classifies cough versus severe obstruction and shows the supervised age-specific response on the correct manikin.
observe.fil: 2.4.15: inihihiwalay ang ubo sa malubhang bara at ipinapakita ang supervised na tugon ayon sa edad sa tamang manikin.

output.fil: Observation sheet ng 2.4.7 at 2.4.15 na pinunan ng trainer.

alternative.en: No trainer or manikins: run only the call-and-AED-request part as a tabletop, leave the skill indicators unrated, and schedule supervised manikin practice.
alternative.fil: Kung walang trainer o manikin: tabletop lamang ng pagtawag at paghingi ng AED, walang rating sa skill indicators, at mag-schedule ng supervised manikin practice.

worksheet.en: Supervised station / observed action / retry or not observed (call and location, correct manikin and age, trainer-approved sequence, AED or next help, no maneuver on a live person)
worksheet.fil: Supervised station / naobserbahang kilos / uulitin o hindi naobserbahan (tawag at lokasyon, tamang manikin at edad, aprubadong sequence, AED o susunod na tulong, walang maneuver sa totoong tao)

title.en: Injury stations with props: bleeding, fracture, burn
title.fil: Mga station sa pinsala gamit ang props: pagdurugo, bali, paso

purpose.en: Show safe first actions on clean props and a dry tabletop, and escalate injuries that need assessment.
purpose.fil: Ipakita ang ligtas na unang kilos sa malinis na props at tuyong tabletop, at i-refer ang pinsalang kailangang masuri.

group_size.en: Triads rotating through three tables; staff rate at each table.
group_size.fil: Tatluhang umiikot sa tatlong mesa; staff ang nagra-rate sa bawat mesa.

materials.en: A simple prop to show support in place
materials.fil: Simpleng prop para ipakita ang suporta sa kasalukuyang posisyon

materials.en: Worksheets and observation sheets for 2.4.10, 2.4.11 and 2.4.14
materials.fil: Worksheet at observation sheet ng 2.4.10, 2.4.11 at 2.4.14

steps.en: 2.4.10 (30 min): cut bleeding through a cloth. The learner protects hands, keeps continuous direct pressure, adds material without removing the first, escalates and reports facts.
steps.fil: 2.4.10 (30 min): hiwang tumatagos ang dugo sa tela. Poprotektahan ng learner ang kamay, tuloy-tuloy na didiinan, magdadagdag ng tela nang hindi inaalis ang una, hihingi ng tulong at mag-uulat ng facts.

steps.en: 2.4.11 (20 min): deformed forearm. The learner supports the part in the position found, explains why not to move or straighten it, and makes the referral call.
steps.fil: 2.4.11 (20 min): deformed na braso. Susuportahan ng learner ang bahagi sa kasalukuyang posisyon, ipapaliwanag kung bakit hindi gagalawin o itutuwid, at tatawag para sa referral.

steps.en: 2.4.14 (20 min, dry): stuck sleeve and ice offered. The learner states cooling per current guidance, leaves stuck clothing in place, declines ice and names referral concerns.
steps.fil: 2.4.14 (20 min, tuyo): dumikit ang manggas at may nag-alok ng yelo. Sasabihin ng learner ang pagpapalamig ayon sa kasalukuyang gabay, hindi aalisin ang dumikit na damit, tatanggihan ang yelo at sasabihin ang dahilan ng referral.

steps.en: Observer gives one strength and one retry action; learner retries before the triad moves on.
steps.fil: Isang lakas at isang retry action mula sa observer; uulit ang learner bago lumipat ang tatluhan.

debrief.en: Which bystander suggestion was hardest to decline, and what did you say?
debrief.fil: Aling mungkahi ng saksi ang pinakamahirap tanggihan, at ano ang sinabi mo?

debrief.en: Which details go in the report to the receiving worker?
debrief.fil: Anong detalye ang isasama sa ulat sa tatanggap?

observe.en: 2.4.10: hand protection, continuous direct pressure, urgent escalation and a factual wound report.
observe.fil: 2.4.10: proteksiyon sa kamay, tuloy-tuloy na direct pressure, agarang referral at malinaw na ulat.

observe.en: 2.4.11: support in place, explains when movement is unsafe, makes the referral call.
observe.fil: 2.4.11: suporta sa posisyon, ipinapaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw, tumatawag para sa referral.

observe.en: 2.4.14: identifies cooling, stuck-clothing boundary and referral concerns.
observe.fil: 2.4.14: tinutukoy ang pagpapalamig, hangganan sa dumikit na damit at dahilan ng referral.

output.en: Three worksheets per learner and staff ratings for indicators 2.4.10, 2.4.11 and 2.4.14.
output.fil: Tatlong worksheet bawat learner at staff rating para sa indicator 2.4.10, 2.4.11 at 2.4.14.

alternative.en: Low-resource: use folded paper as the cloth and a rolled newspaper as the prop; solo learners talk through each case and are observed later.
alternative.fil: Kung kulang sa gamit: tiniklop na papel bilang tela at binilot na diyaryo bilang prop; ang mag-isa ay magsasalaysay ng kaso at oobserbahan pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Element / observed evidence / next action (protect, pressure, support, keep still, cool, referral, confirmed contact)
worksheet.fil: Elemento / nakitang ebidensya / susunod na hakbang (proteksiyon, diin, suporta, hindi paggalaw, pagpapalamig, referral, kumpirmadong contact)

purpose.en: Decline the harmful shortcut in each case, keep people safe, and make a clear call for help or transport.
purpose.fil: Tanggihan ang mapanganib na shortcut sa bawat kaso, panatilihing ligtas ang lahat, at tumawag nang malinaw para sa tulong o transport.

group_size.en: Triads; partner plays the bystander pushing the shortcut; staff rate.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan; ang partner ang gaganap na saksing nagtutulak ng shortcut; staff ang nagra-rate.

materials.en: Participant cards, worksheets and observation sheets for 2.4.5, 2.4.8, 2.4.9, 2.4.12, 2.4.13 and 2.4.16
materials.fil: Participant cards, worksheet at observation sheet ng 2.4.5, 2.4.8, 2.4.9, 2.4.12, 2.4.13 at 2.4.16

materials.en: A fictional product label (no real chemicals)
materials.fil: Kathang-isip na label ng produkto (walang totoong kemikal)

materials.en: Job aid with the confirmed emergency and poison-advice contacts
materials.fil: Job aid na may kumpirmadong emergency at poison-advice contact

steps.en: 2.4.5 convulsion (20 min): clear the simulated space, call for help, state start time and observations, decline restraint and the spoon.
steps.fil: 2.4.5 kombulsyon (20 min): linisin ang paligid, humingi ng tulong, sabihin ang oras ng simula at nakita, tanggihan ang pagpigil at kutsara.

steps.en: 2.4.8 drowning (15 min) and 2.4.9 poisoning (20 min): stay on the shore, call trained rescue and state the need for assessment; keep the scene clear of exposure and read the fictional label into the call.
steps.fil: 2.4.8 pagkalunod (15 min) at 2.4.9 pagkalason (20 min): manatili sa pampang, tawagin ang sanay na rescuer at sabihing kailangan ng pagsusuri; iwasan ang exposure at basahin ang kathang-isip na label sa tawag.

steps.en: 2.4.12 sting (15 min) and 2.4.13 snakebite (15 min): sort local from urgent signs and call help for breathing difficulty, stating medicine limits; decline the cord and walking, keep the person still and call transport.
steps.fil: 2.4.12 tusok (15 min) at 2.4.13 ahas (15 min): ihiwalay ang lokal sa agarang senyales at tumawag para sa hirap sa paghinga, sabihin ang hangganan sa gamot; tanggihan ang tali at paglalakad, panatilihing hindi gumagalaw at tumawag ng transport.

steps.en: 2.4.16 chest pain (20 min): activate the urgent pathway, hand over onset and symptoms, and leave medicine decisions to local protocol and qualified advice.
steps.fil: 2.4.16 dibdib (20 min): gamitin ang agarang referral, iulat ang simula at sintomas, at ipaubaya ang pasya sa gamot sa lokal na protocol at kwalipikadong payo.

steps.en: After each case: one strength, one retry action, retry, rotate roles.
steps.fil: Pagkatapos ng bawat kaso: isang lakas, isang retry action, ulitin, magpalit ng papel.

debrief.en: Which shortcut came up most, and what words helped you decline it?
debrief.fil: Aling shortcut ang pinakamadalas lumabas, at anong salita ang nakatulong sa pagtanggi?

debrief.en: Where does the decision about medicines belong?
debrief.fil: Kanino nakasalalay ang pasya tungkol sa gamot?

observe.en: 2.4.5: clears space, calls help, states time and observations, rejects restraint and mouth insertion.
observe.fil: 2.4.5: nililinis ang paligid, humihingi ng tulong, sinasabi ang oras at nakita, tinatanggihan ang pagpigil at kutsara.

observe.en: 2.4.8: safe shore response, activates trained rescue, states need for medical assessment.
observe.fil: 2.4.8: ligtas na tugon sa pampang, tinatawag ang sanay na rescuer, sinasabing kailangan ng pagsusuri.

observe.en: 2.4.9: information call from the fictional label while keeping the scene clear of exposure.
observe.fil: 2.4.9: tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang exposure.

observe.en: 2.4.12: sorts local versus urgent signs, activates help for breathing difficulty, states medication boundaries.
observe.fil: 2.4.12: inihihiwalay ang lokal at agarang senyales, humihingi ng tulong sa hirap sa paghinga, sinasabi ang saklaw ng gamot.

observe.en: 2.4.13: rejects the cord and walking, keeps the person still, calls for transport.
observe.fil: 2.4.13: tinatanggihan ang tali at paglalakad, pinananatiling hindi gumagalaw, tumatawag ng transport.

observe.en: 2.4.16: activates the urgent pathway, hands over onset and symptoms, does not prescribe aspirin.
observe.fil: 2.4.16: gumagamit ng agarang referral, iniuulat ang simula at sintomas, hindi nagrereseta ng aspirin.

output.en: Six worksheets per learner and staff ratings for the six indicators.
output.fil: Anim na worksheet bawat learner at staff rating para sa anim na indicator.

alternative.en: Low-resource: read each case aloud and have the whole group call out the shortcut and the safe call; still observe individuals later for ratings.
alternative.fil: Kung kulang sa gamit: basahin nang malakas ang kaso at sabay-sabay sabihin ng grupo ang shortcut at ligtas na tawag; obserbahan pa rin ang bawat isa pagkatapos para sa rating.

worksheet.en: Element / observed evidence / next action (shortcut declined, help or transport called, information given, confirmed contact, time and handover)
worksheet.fil: Elemento / nakitang ebidensya / susunod na hakbang (tinanggihang shortcut, tinawagang tulong o transport, ibinigay na impormasyon, kumpirmadong contact, oras at handover)

purpose.en: Check a simulated kit against the current local list, record every row, and name who replaces missing or damaged items.
purpose.fil: Suriin ang simulated kit ayon sa kasalukuyang lokal na listahan, punan ang bawat hanay, at tukuyin kung sino ang magpapalit ng kulang o sira.

group_size.en: Triads, one kit per triad; staff rate each learner.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan, isang kit bawat tatluhan; staff ang nagra-rate sa bawat isa.

materials.fil: Kasalukuyang lokal na listahan ng kit

materials.en: A simulated kit with an old inventory sheet, an expired item and an unsealed packet
materials.fil: Simulated kit na may lumang inventory sheet, expired item at bukas na pakete
Kit worksheet at observation sheet ng 2.4.17

steps.en: Show the local list and say: having an item does not authorize using it.
steps.fil: Ipakita ang lokal na listahan at sabihin: hindi pahintulot gumamit ang pagkakaroon ng gamit.

steps.en: Each learner fills every row: quantity, seal or condition, expiry, storage and replacement owner.
steps.fil: Pupunan ng bawat learner ang bawat hanay: dami, selyo o kondisyon, expiry, imbakan at responsable sa palit.

steps.en: The learner sets aside expired or damaged items without using them and escalates them to the named owner.
steps.fil: Ihihiwalay ng learner ang expired o sirang gamit nang hindi ginagamit at iuulat sa itinalagang responsable.

steps.en: Staff check the sheet with the learner; one strength, one retry action, retry the missed rows.
steps.fil: Susuriin ng staff ang sheet kasama ang learner; isang lakas, isang retry action, ulitin ang nalaktawang hanay.

debrief.en: Who in your barangay replaces kit items, and how will you tell them?
debrief.fil: Sino sa inyong barangay ang nagpapalit ng laman ng kit, at paano mo sila sasabihan?

debrief.en: Which items in the kit need an authorized person to use them?
debrief.fil: Aling gamit sa kit ang kailangan ng awtorisadong tao bago gamitin?

observe.en: 2.4.17: completes every row of the simulated local kit inventory and names a replenishment owner.
observe.fil: 2.4.17: napupunan ang bawat hanay ng simulated kit inventory at natutukoy ang responsable sa pagpapalit.

output.en: One completed kit inventory per learner with a named replacement owner.
output.fil: Isang kumpletong kit inventory bawat learner na may nakapangalang responsable sa palit.

alternative.en: No kit available: use a printed picture list or empty labelled boxes; learners later inspect the real BHS kit with the supervisor.
alternative.fil: Kung walang kit: gumamit ng larawang listahan o walang-lamang kahon na may label; susuriin ng learner ang totoong BHS kit kasama ang supervisor pagkatapos.

worksheet.en: Item on local list / quantity / seal or condition / expiry / replacement owner; storage and next check date
worksheet.fil: Item sa lokal na listahan / dami / selyo o kondisyon / expiry / responsable sa palit; imbakan at susunod na petsa ng pagsusuri
